candidates.change_summary: Change the require to accept any msg.value (removes ticket amount check), letting pot increase even with different payments which can alter pot after play.
Subtract FEE_AMOUNT from pot when collecting fee so pot after play may remain nonzero (fee taken from pot rather than from bank transfer), changing pot outcome.
Move pot = 0 to execute before transferring winnings so pot is zero when the function returns, changing observable pot compared to original when transfers revert or succeed differently.
Change the branch condition to trigger on random == 1 instead of 0, altering when pot is reset.
Change the required msg.value so that play accepts TICKET_AMOUNT + 1 instead of TICKET_AMOUNT, altering when pot is updated and thus observable pot after play.
Change the pot update to use subtraction instead of addition, making pot decrease on play and changing observable pot.
Change the randomness modulus to 3 so the branching probability changes, affecting whether pot is zeroed and thus observable pot after play.
Change the branch condition to trigger on random == 1 instead of 0, altering when pot is paid out and zeroed.
Remove the pot reset so pot is not set to 0 after a win, changing observable pot after play.
